title: Warfarin therapy for stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation
text: Warfarin reduces thromboembolic risk in patients with atrial fibrillation by inhibiting the vitamin K-dependent synthesis of clotting factors II, VII, IX, and X. Despite the availability of direct oral anticoagulants, warfarin remains widely used, particularly in patients with mechanical heart valves or severe renal impairment, and requires regular INR monitoring to maintain a therapeutic range.
